statements.note: Impact claim settled by a changed public type: ServerContext (packages/mcp-server/src/types.ts) drops the required field organizationSlug and adds a required field constraints. ServerContext is the parameter type of exported startStdio (./transports/stdio export) and configureServer (./server export) of the published @sentry/mcp-server package, and in-repo callers (chat.ts, start-mock-stdio.ts, index.ts, many tests) had to be edited to compile. Judgment: the author's surrounding sentence scopes compatibility to clients connecting to /mcp or /sse, which this check does not refute; under that narrower reading the claim would be CANNOT_TELL, not TRUE.
evidence: gh api repos/getsentry/sentry-mcp/pulls/501/files: types.ts patch removes 'organizationSlug: string | null;' and adds 'constraints: UrlConstraints;' to ServerContext
chat.ts, start-mock-stdio.ts, mcp-server/src/index.ts, whoami.test.ts and ~18 other test files changed organizationSlug -> constraints in calls
